name: xjtlu-web
description: 靠浦：重塑校园生活的可能

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --prefix server && npm run type-check --prefix web
scripts.verify:full: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test:integration --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web && npm run verify:budgets --prefix web
scripts.verify:materials: npm run materials:verify --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.audit:production: npm audit --omit=dev --prefix server && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix web && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix desktop
scripts.audit:tooling: npm audit && npm audit --prefix server && npm audit --prefix web && npm audit --prefix desktop
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:full && npm run db:validate --prefix server && npm run db:status --prefix server && npm run db:verify:baseline --prefix server && npm run db:verify:backup --prefix server && npm run audit:production
